_doc: RES-d self-description drift allowlist (PRD-gap-close-canon §Automated Self-Description Counter; ADR-005 §Decision 2). Each axis reads its truth from a substrate-exposed source; every policed site below must agree with that truth. Allowlist-anchored, not a blind tree grep — the tree legitimately carries distinct 'N skills' / 'N MCP tools' figures about other subjects (a Ramp/Glass case study's 350 skills; VisionClaw's native 7 MCP tools; agentbox's 180+ MCP tools total), none of which describe a tracked axis.

source_pin._doc: The skills and mcp-ontology-tools axes read their truth from a SIBLING repository. Unpinned, the gate compared canon prose against whatever agentbox HEAD the runner happened to fetch, so the same canon commit could pass on Monday and fail on Tuesday with no canon change — the counter measured the sibling's motion, not the canon's drift. The counter now requires the agentbox checkout to be at this revision and fails otherwise (override: --allow-pin-drift, which downgrades the mismatch to a warning). Moving the pin is a reviewed edit to this file, which is exactly the point: a change in truth becomes a diff. CI pins the same revision via the checkout `ref:` in .github/workflows/drift-counter.yml — keep the two in step.

skills.label: agentbox skill count

denominator.counts: skill directories in the agentbox checkout that contain a SKILL.md
denominator.authority: agentbox scripts/skill-count-check.js, field .count (ADR-037 D8 — one SKILL.md per skill directory is the single source of truth)
denominator.excludes: nested skill sets vendored inside another skill (skills/*/*/SKILL.md), the 610 external turbo-flow agent templates, and agent specs — none of which are agentbox skills
denominator._doc: Stated so a reader can settle what a policed figure is claiming without reading the counter. 'N skills' at a policed site means THIS number.

skills._files_note: The live self-description surface only. Two classes of prose are deliberately NOT whole-file scanned. (1) The book/report prose under presentation/ is a dated narrative artifact that uses 'N agent skills' rhetorically (e.g. a '10-15 agent skills' pilot-selection range, a TCO example); its current-count references are reconciled by hand and recorded in the evidence file. (2) Accepted ADRs under docs/adr/ and docs/engineering/ state the figure that held WHEN THE DECISION WAS TAKEN — docs/engineering/ADR-004 §Context reads '115 skills' as of 2026-07-08. An ADR Context paragraph is a dated record, not a live self-description; rewriting it to track the current count would falsify the decision record. Removed from this list on 2026-09-05 for that reason; the current figure is carried in that ADR's dated acceptance annex instead.

denominator.counts: tool descriptors registered by the agentbox ontology bridge MCP server
denominator.expression: number of top-level elements of the `const TOOLS = [ … ];` array in mcp/servers/ontology-bridge.js (object literals and bare imported references; nested inputSchema objects are indented deeper and are not elements)
denominator.excludes: agentbox's ~180 MCP tools in total across all its servers, and VisionClaw's own native MCP tools — neither describes this axis
denominator._doc: 'N MCP tools' at a policed site means the ontology BRIDGE's tools specifically, not agentbox's whole MCP surface.

sites._moved_2026-09-05: ADR-002 was archived to docs/archive/adr/ in the ADR consolidation; these two sites pointed at the pre-archive path and reported `file-missing` on every run — a policed site that cannot be read is a hole in the gate, not a pass. Repointed to the archived path.

sites.pattern: Ontology bridge health check \((\d+) tools respond\)

ontology-classes.label: VisionClaw ontology owl:Class count

denominator.counts: distinct owl:Class declarations in the VisionClaw canonical ontology
denominator.expression: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a owl:Class } over the published ontology graph, excluding imported upstream vocabularies
denominator.authority: VisionClaw ClassCountSource — NOT YET PUBLISHED as a script-queryable committed count
denominator.excludes: owl:Restriction and other anonymous class expressions; classes from imported vocabularies
denominator._doc: Defined here in advance so that when the source is published the axis can be switched on without re-litigating what the figure means.

ontology-classes.reason: VisionClaw ClassCountSource (ddd-gap-close-visionclaw-context.md:155) is `planned`, not published as a script-queryable committed count this wave. Partial-source failure mode (ADR-005 §Decision 2): axis reported UNAVAILABLE, not enforced; a source being down blocks the axis, not the whole gate.

resolution.blocked_on: VisionClaw publishing a committed count file (or an equivalent queryable endpoint) for its ontology owl:Class total
resolution.unblocks_via: set DRIFT_VISIONCLAW_CLASS_COUNT_FILE to the committed count file (or DRIFT_VISIONCLAW_CLASS_COUNT to the integer); the axis then enforces with no code change
resolution._doc: An axis that is 'unavailable' with no stated exit condition is indistinguishable from an axis nobody intends to finish. This records what would resolve it, who owns it, and the exact switch.

roster.label: forum agent_registry roster size

denominator.counts: agents registered in the nostr-rust-forum agent_registry
denominator.expression: number of rows in the forum's agent_registry, once the forum exposes it as a script-queryable surface
denominator.excludes: the 610 external turbo-flow agent templates and the agentbox skill count; a registered agent is neither a template nor a skill
denominator._doc: This axis is the most commonly confused figure in the canon, hence the explicit exclusions.

roster.reason: Not yet single-sourced; the forum must expose agent_registry as script-queryable before the counter can track it (DDD-gap-close-canon-context §12 open issue 3). Distinct from the 610 external turbo-flow templates and from the skill count.

resolution.blocked_on: nostr-rust-forum exposing agent_registry as a script-queryable surface (committed count file or CLI/HTTP query)
resolution.unblocks_via: add a source query of kind `forum-roster-count` to drift-counter.mjs and populate this axis's `sites`
